name: joint_precision_band_rgb_planning_v15
purpose: stationary RGB centering and active zoom across four corners and five initial magnifications

control_execution.note: Seven physical fixed pulses; action response learned from real RGB transitions; no duration or Q network

frozen_frontend.reid: existing verified FastReID VeRi SBS R50-IBN 2048-dim
frozen_frontend.authorization: User requested detector fine-tuning;12epochs plus independent image and44live development-start gates passed; freeze this new checkpoint during RL

seed_policy.validation_use: not automatic; user stopped extended v10 validation

progression.initialization: v13 audited response coefficients; no new training or optimizer; old training rewards retained as historical data only
progression.checkpoint_selection: same single frozen response model; changed RGB planning/environment reward;20+40complete development

metric_contract.center_error: sqrt((2*cx-1)^2+(2*cy-1)^2), computed from the selected RGB detection
metric_contract.scale_log_error: abs(log(area_ratio/0.04)); unavailable detections do not become zeros
metric_contract.availability: time-weighted valid selected detections and separate offline correct-GT matching coverage
metric_contract.offline_gt: identity/false-positive and visibility diagnostics only; cannot influence state/action/reward or reset aiming
metric_contract.stable_hold: entire required hold window after settling, not only one terminal frame; every action-end RGB observation logged
metric_contract.loss_run_seconds: sum of action durations during consecutive unavailable selected detections
metric_contract.rapid_unwarranted_reversal: opposite same-axis commands <=0.5s apart while preceding observed axis error<=0.03, followed by error worsening>=0.02
metric_contract.total_direction_reversals: sum of opposite nonzero commands on the same pan/tilt/zoom axis; Stay and other-axis commands do not erase the preceding command; normalized per10 actual simulation seconds
metric_contract.settling_time: first time after which the complete required stable-hold window meets center/scale bounds
metric_contract.oscillation_note: Necessary direction changes during actual motion are not automatically counted as unstable reversals
metric_contract.confidence: confidence alone is never a task-success criterion; detector threshold remains frozen
metric_contract.sampling_limit: metrics summarize actual closed-loop action-end RGB samples; no claim of continuous pixel truth between samples

stages.gate_note: development60/60; independent validation requires a separate run and is not automatic

corner_initialization.physical_time_budget_basis: 20-second horizon and12-second settling gate retained for joint task; actual success must be measured
corner_initialization.sky_exclusion: fixed downward pitch limits[-80,-40],FOV[14,66]; no camera translation
corner_initialization.asset_note: Native1.0vehicle; frozen overhead-adapted detector; fixed location and initial orientation

split_contract.train: no new training; source v13 training only
split_contract.prior_results: v10 was user-stopped72/120; no qualification claim or automatic promotion

coverage.magnification_definition: tan(62deg/2)/tan(horizontalFOV/2); geometric perspective magnification, not digital resize
coverage.scale_interpretation: native vehicle scale, initial FOV changes optical-equivalent magnification, FOV actively controlled thereafter

probe_schedule.0: same fixed v13 balanced20 then disjoint40; all development, not independent

coverage.calibration: 60initial RGB conditions; evidence of visibility/scale and command response, not control success

algorithm: Frozen learned RGB response planning with explicit center and scale inner-band cost
